title: A repeat miss on points to basis points: a new method
source: Percent Session, the basis-point slip that came up three times (TUTOR_SPEC section 7, T3)

history.tutor: A rate falls from 7.5% to 7.2%. How many basis points did it fall?

graderChecks: Does it use a method other than restating the rule or a worked example (for example a half-done choice)?
Does it name the slip in one sentence?
Does it set one similar item with new numbers?
Does it leave percent change alone (no re-explaining it)?
notes: Pass when: uses a method not in methods_used (for example a half-done choice). Names the slip in one sentence. One similar item with new numbers. 60 words or fewer. Does not re-explain percent change. The Skill has three misses before this answer, but a right answer broke the run, so 0.3 is the second miss in a row: under the decided ladder that brings the next unused method, where a third miss in a row would offer to park (T7). Code shows the Quick try the earlier turn talks about (7.5% to 7.2%, answer 30 bp), so the Learner's 0.3 is that try's Known mistake (stopped at points).
